item.title: Comment on ‘Safer Roads’ Conference And Exhibition To Take Place In Killarney Next Month by John Teahan
item.description: Hi . John Teahan is my name and i work as a Paramedic Supervisor with the National Ambulance Service . I drove abroad recently in Lithuania and Australia. When i returned home i came to the conclusion that our speed limits are much higher in Ireland than these countries having driven abroad .Even allowing for road conditions there compared to here i feel we need to reduce our speed limits which would in my opinion reduce serious road traffic collisions . Regards John Teahan
